title: Vanilla Apocalypse
description: A Forge mod that enhances zombie behavior, making them faster, stronger, and more dangerous while creating a harsher survival experience.
body: Vanilla Apocalypse makes Minecraft survival far more intense and thrilling: zombies are faster, stronger, and tougher, with increased health, attack damage, and detection range. They actively hunt players and villagers, creating constant danger. Every village and nighttime encounter becomes unpredictable, offering a true zombie apocalypse experience while keeping the vanilla Minecraft aesthetic.
